title: CI Webhook Gateway
summary: Receives GitHub webhook deliveries, verifies the HMAC signature (fail-closed), parses pull_request events against the gated branch (dev), and dispatches the gated CI pipeline by kicking the Jenkins oyaCiLane lane. The missing trigger that turns a PR event into a real, gated CI run — retiring the manual admin-relax-merge seam.
contract_notes: No proto3/gRPC surface: this is an HTTP webhook receiver + Jenkins dispatcher, not an inter-service gRPC API. The proto3 design surface is deliberately deferred (see registry/design-spec-maturity/wave-3-i-deferred-surfaces.tsv).

regulatory_packs.note: Substrate runs entirely on GitHub (interim) + Jenkins per ADR-0363/0247; no third-party CI control-plane dependency. Air-gap-capable per ADR-0164. No tenant data resident in this service — only repo-coordination metadata (PR numbers, commit SHAs, branch names).

data_residency.note: The gateway handles repo-coordination metadata only. No tenant PII. Residency follows the host cluster region; multi-region is N/A (single substrate instance per forge).

audit_chain.emission_contract: ADR-0263 observability emission contract; every dispatch decision and every signature rejection emits one audit-chain row keyed by delivery_id.

mesh_layering.non_claim: No Istio/Cilium/Envoy runtime configuration is implemented by this scaffold; the declaration records the ADR-0148 Tier-1 + Tier-2 layering intent that the deploy substrate provisions.

tenant_isolation: N/A — substrate service, not tenant-scoped. Runs in the oya-ci namespace; no cross-tenant data path.

dispatch_targets.status_sink: GitHub Commit Status API (posted by Jenkins, not by this gateway)
